name: Light
description: Low weight creates levity and mobility

name: Heavy
description: High weight grounds and stabilizes

name: Hot
description: Heating quality stimulates metabolism and sharpens action

name: Cold
description: Cooling quality soothes heat and slows metabolic activity

name: Oily
description: Lubricating and unctuous moistens tissues and can increase kapha

name: Dry
description: Absorbing and drying increases vata and reduces moisture

name: Smooth
description: Soft and even in texture soothing and pacifying

name: Rough
description: Coarse or abrasive increases dryness and vata

name: Stable
description: Fixed and steady grounding and strengthening

name: Mobile
description: Active and moving dispersing

name: Dense
description: Compact and heavy in substance consolidating and grounding

name: Subtle
description: Fine and penetrating light in action and often vata-associated

name: Sharp
description: Piercing and cutting quality stimulates pitta and vata

name: Soft
description: Delicate and yielding gentle and nourishing

name: Liquid
description: Fluid and flowing enhances transport and absorption

name: Firm
description: Solid and resistant stabilizes structure and function

name: Clear
description: Transparent and purifying supports clarity and lightness

name: Cloudy
description: Opaque or turbid can cause heaviness or obstruction

name: Sticky
description: Adhesive and binding increases kapha and may obstruct flow

name: Bland
description: Mild and lacking pungency often cooling and grounding
